description: `given @a, @b :>` over two `Item | not` CELLS, with only @a set present: the markup guard renders nothing and the handler guard's body does not run (@msg unchanged). Pre-s461 impl#1 lowered both heads to undeclared bare JS names (ReferenceError).
rationale: §42.2.3: "Multi-narrowing is all-or-nothing. If any listed variable is `not`, the body is skipped entirely. There is no partial execution of the body with a subset of variables present." §42.5: `given x, y :> body` → `if (x !== null && x !== undefined && y !== null && y !== undefined) { body }`.
